text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Classes are over! I did my best in
training again!
#ItsBreakTime for
#CuteCurrenChan"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Great work, Curren Chan! Where are you
heading
now?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Thanks! ♪ I'm off to find the kind of
cuteness that
can put a smile on
everyone's face! ☆

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Sh-she's so cute!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This is Curren Chan. She uses the handle
"Curren"
on social media and is
incredibly popular.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At the moment, however, another
Umamusume is
gazing intently at her
from a distance...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Waaagh!
choice_data_list: カレンに用事かな、ヤエノ？
choice_data_list_en: Did you need Curren for something, Yaeno?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
You startled me... Please refrain from
doing that.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Ahem... You asked whether I have
business with
Curren, yes? The answer is
that I do not.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
However, I find that Curren carries
herself in a
splendid manner, and thus I
decided to observe
her.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Despite leading a busy life with an
arduous
training regimen, she still
manages to maintain a
high frequency of
posts on Umastagram.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
And the quality of her content remains

consistently high. As a result, her
Umasta page is
extremely cute.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Hm?! I... I would not claim to be a fan.
As a
practitioner of the Kongo Yaegaki
style, my heart
remains steadfast!
choice_data_list_en: You really are a fan, huh.
You really are a fan, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Well, p-perhaps it wavers slightly... but
Curren
does not rely on her innate
cuteness alone—she is
always refining
her craft...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
And that is why I hold the utmost
respect for her.
I hesitate to call myself a
fan, however—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Hm? Waaaaah!
choice_data_list_en: N-Next to me, next to me...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I had no idea you were a fan of mine,
Yaeno. I'm
so happy! My heart skipped a
beat just now! ☆

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
We should totally run together
sometime! I hope
you'll keep cheering
me on! ♪

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I want to protect you!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I can deny it no longer! I simply cannot
bear to
forsake so lovely a flower!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I must protect you using my Kongo
Yaegaki style!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I implore you! Please allow me to defend
you from
harm!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Wow, this is amazing! ♪ Have I finally
reached
bodyguard-level popularity?!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I don't know what to do! I'm really
pleased
you want to keep me safe, but I
think having
security might be a teensy
bit much...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you're right! I've gotta match the
energy of
my fans!
choice_data_list: 大丈夫！守ってもらおう！
まずは落ち着かせるべきかも……
choice_data_list_en: Don't worry! We'll have them protect us!
Maybe we should calm them down first...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Will you protect my cuteness, Yaeno?
Pretty
please! ☆

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for agreeing to this interview
Curren
Chan. It's very much appreciated.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: You're very welcome. ♪

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: S-so first off... Um, uhh...

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, who is that intimidating individual
behind
you?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yaeno is my valiant knight. ☆

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Your "knight"?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Curren Chan later tells me that, perhaps
due to
Yaeno Muteki's intimidating aura,
the reporter's
questions were far less
pointed than usual.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Great idea! I'm just so cute that she can't
think
straight! Okay, so what should I
do?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Whaaat? I don't think I know how. ☆
choice_data_list: カワイくないことを言うしかない！
choice_data_list_en: We have no choice but to say something un-cute!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I mean, I've never not been cute—not even for a millisecond! ♪

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Curren Chan is so CUUUTE!
